verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer one-time-passcode app with an open-source project and PAM module, and products of this kind can plausibly offer developer APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no versioned API and no deprecation policy. The GitHub implementations and PAM module are building blocks, not a versioned API with a deprecation commitment, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
